def calculate_sum_set_size(T):
    """Calculates the number of distinct elements in the set {t_i + t_j | 0 <= i <= j <= N}."""
    sum_set = set()
    n = len(T)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i, n):
            sum_set.add(T[i] + T[j])
    return len(sum_set)
